title: Rtl1 and CD31 double-immunohistochemistry
protocol: Embed fresh placenta in OCT compound immediately after removal.
Freeze the OCT-embedded placenta in cooled 2-methyl butane bathed in liquid nitrogen.
Cut the frozen block into 5 μm sections using a cryostat and air dry at room temperature.
Fix the sections in 4% paraformaldehyde for 10 minutes.
Wash the fixed slides in 0.01M PBS three times, each for 5 minutes.
Treat the slides with 0.3% H2O2/methanol for 15 minutes.
Wash the treated slides in 0.01M PBS three times, each for 10 minutes.
Incubate the slides in a drop of normal goat serum for 10 minutes at room temperature in a moist chamber.
Discard the serum and incubate the slides with a drop of first antibody mixture (anti-Peg11, anti-CD31, and BSA) for one hour at room temperature in a moist chamber.
Wash the slides in 0.01M PBS three times, each for 10 minutes.
Incubate the slides in a drop of normal goat serum for one minute at room temperature in a moist chamber.

Discard the serum and incubate the slides with a drop of second antibody mixture (Alexa Fluor 488 anti-rat IgG, Cy3-conjugated Goat anti-rabbit IgG, Hoechst33342, and BSA) for one hour at room temperature in a dark moist chamber.
Wash the slides in 0.01M PBS for 10 minutes.
Apply a drop of 50% glycerol to each specimen.
Cover the specimens with coverslips.
Seal the edges of the coverslips with nail polish.
Observe under fluorescence microscope.
Set excitation and emission filters for Alexa 488 (Excitation: 495, Emission: 520).
Set excitation and emission filters for Cy3 (Excitation: 512/552, Emission: 570).
Set excitation and emission filters for Hoechst33342 (Excitation: 360, Emission: 450).
